question: Can all-pass throwing profiles support descriptions like the UFA six-passer article?
scope: 2026 regular season, all lines, named throwers; physical passes exclude stalls.
independentChartChecks: All six example pass counts, mean gains and non-huck mean gains independently recomputed with csv.DictReader and math.fsum; match within 1e-10. All six have complete cp coverage.

repeatability.method: Per-player chronological first half of observed games vs remaining games; >=50 non-stall throws per half. Exploratory same-season rank correlation, not a future-season validation.

definitions.xcp: Mean supplied cp over non-stall passes with non-missing cp.
definitions.sourceCpoe: (Completed passes + recorded drops) / all non-stall passes minus mean available cp, matching cached player-game aggregate convention. Drops receive thrower success credit. Expected completion excludes missing cp; matchedCpoe retains a sensitivity using only scored passes in both terms. All six examples have complete cp coverage. The stored per-pass cpoe field equals 1 on drops and is not averaged.
definitions.completionRate: Actual completions / all non-stall passes, including drops as incompletions.
definitions.huck: Forward gain >30 yards AND Euclidean flight >40 yards, strictly.
definitions.directions: Forward: gain > abs(lateral displacement). Backward: -gain > abs(lateral displacement). Lateral: remainder. Exact 45-degree boundaries are lateral. Disc direction does not identify a cutting route or forehand/backhand.
definitions.hockeyAssists: Completed immediately preceding pass before a source goal (event type 19), verified unique consecutive possession_throw, same game/team/quarter/point/possession, receiver=next thrower, increasing unique global_event_seq.
definitions.throwerAec: Sum supplied aec including stalls, with drops credited zero to thrower; source model, no division by attempts.
definitions.percentile: Midrank among eligible throwers, descriptive style position, not quality.

caveats: One regular-season game (Pittsburgh at Chicago) has no exported throws; both teams have incomplete coverage.
The article was published June 23. Our main comparison uses all exported 2026 regular-season games, not its historical snapshot.
These are descriptive dimensions and candidate role interpretations, not validated discrete archetypes.
xCP/CPOE are supplied-model assessments; current exports may include revised model values. No independent calibration or future-year skill validation is claimed.

Lag contribution and on-field possession denominators are not columns in the five exports. Cached aggregate samples do not supply complete comparable season coverage, so LC and per-100-possession claims are not reproduced.
No receiver route, defender position, wind, mark, intent, vision, or causal effect on a lineup is inferred.
CPOE credit treats drops differently from actual completion; the two cannot be subtracted interchangeably.

Verified pre-assist counts are derived from unambiguous event links; they differ from cached official HockeyAssists in 21 of 991 checked player-games. These are not presented as exact official hockey-assist totals.

There are 18 non-stall passes without cp. Official-style CPOE and an alternative using matched modeled-pass denominators differ for those players; all six article examples have complete modeled-pass coverage.
